HardwareFilter.Description: 0.1 Hz high-pass and 50 Hz notch (online, hardware)

TaskDescription: Kinesthetic motor imagery of gait alternated with relaxation and a regressive-count distractor task while walking with a fully assisted lower-limb exoskeleton on flat ground. Trial duration: 9.0s.
Description: EEG database for the cognitive assessment of motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton (DECODED, a EUROBENCH sub-project); flat-ground (EXPERIENCE) scenario.
